subtitles.zh: 理想情况下，如果联合国改革与金融机构改革同步推进会很好，但这可能过于雄心勃勃。
subtitles.en: Ideally, it would be good if we have UN reform moving parallel with the reform of the financial institutions, but that might be too ambitious.

subtitles.zh: 但如果能对国际金融机构进行系统性、渐进式的改革，例如为大量成员国带来优惠融资，
subtitles.en: But if we can have small movements, incremental movements with the IFIs that are systemic and that will bring concessional financing, for example, to a large number of member states,

subtitles.zh: 特别是发展中国家，我认为这将改善世界上许多人的处境。
subtitles.en: especially developing member states, I think that will make things better for a lot of our people in the world.

subtitles.zh: 但我也想谈谈人工智能，因为我相信人工智能可以成为一股向善的力量。
subtitles.en: But I also want to speak about AI, because I believe that AI can be a force for good.

subtitles.zh: 但年轻人担心人工智能会夺走他们的工作，扼杀他们的创造力。
subtitles.en: But young people are concerned that AI will take their jobs, will kill their creativity.

subtitles.zh: 因此，联合国汇聚193个成员国的智慧，可以制定一个人工智能治理框架，平衡创新与民众关切。
subtitles.en: And so this UN, the wisdom of the 193, I believe, can come together to have an AI governance framework that can balance innovation and not stifle creativity and, at the same time,

subtitles.zh: 玛丽亚·费尔南德斯-埃斯皮诺萨。
subtitles.en: the concerns of our people. Maria Finerne-Espinoza.

subtitles.zh: 我认为联合国和秘书长有能力召集、合作和倡导。
subtitles.en: Well, I think the UN and the Secretary-General is equipped to convene, to partner, to advocate.

subtitles.zh: 这正是当今世界所需要的。
subtitles.en: And that's exactly what we need in the world of today.

subtitles.zh: 你问到了私营部门的作用。
subtitles.en: You asked about the role of the private sector.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这一点至关重要，因为这是创新、就业和资源的来源，正是发展中国家当前所需。
subtitles.en: And I think this is absolutely critical, because that's where we see innovation, we see jobs, we see resources, and that's what developing countries need right now.
